translation_notes: region is a statement run at module level: `state`, `graph` and `ns_rdf` come from context_shim.py (subset of the pyRdfa execution context, `state` reduced to the five members the region calls); `@graph graph` is added before the `if`

the two adds on heads[i] (rdf:first, rdf:rest) are one `+{ s p1 o1 ; p2 o2 }`; the two single adds (rdf:nil for an empty list, the anchor) stay one `+{ }` each, as there is no second property on their subject
`ns_rdf["nil"|"first"|"rest"]` becomes `rdf:nil|first|rest` through `@prefix rdf:` (pyRdfa's ns_rdf is that namespace); `ns_rdf` is still imported by both sides but unused on the ldpy side
`vals == None` kept as is (a Python test on data, not an RDF operation); BNode() list heads kept in Python, since they are built before the triples and indexed (heads[i+1])
